decision: Approve one source-bound hosted integration run after the reviewed source commit is published. This is not a release or quality approval.
root_source_review: Ordinary recognition remains one complete decoded-waveform pass with word_timestamps=False and the previous effective decoder settings.

Optional postpass receives independent copies of accepted text/native tokens/seek, recomputes the full frontend, uses the same native model sequentially, and cannot call recognition through its align-only adapter.

Candidate source strings/order and physical bounds are checked; localized timing conflict fallback retains original intervals and clears only unusable optional word evidence. A late optional failure preserves the full original baseline.
Speaker-backend failures cannot mutate the baseline; timing warnings and provenance persist while raw private words are discarded after alignment.

Production releases the cached recognizer before speaker inference and all audio caches before text inference; the actual hosted fixture observes the first boundary, while the second remains covered by source and weak-reference/order controls.
The native timing bridge is restricted to the inspected faster-whisper 1.2.1/CTranslate2 4.9.1 interface; other runtimes visibly fall back while ordinary recognition remains usable.
The summary AST differs from the prior production source in exactly three prompt-ending literals. No model/schema/context/point-count/grounding/chunking/unload change is included.
hosted_observation_review: Original complete 34.635-second constructed recording, four source identities, native model files and post-inference voice annotations are pinned. References never reach model requests.
Actual one-pass recognition, same full PCM for timing, raw native alignment before validation, acoustic turns, cache lifetime, persistent/reloaded transcript and exports are retained.
New strict process-group measurements reject incomplete membership/RSS evidence; native/phase/overall limits and owned cleanup remain checked after exit.
Pinned ECAPA YAML declarations are checked without constructing objects during the separately authorized hosted recovery; current absent YAML was not claimed inspected.
remaining_limits: Controlled exposed English readings do not establish Greek, noisy, overlapping or natural-meeting speaker accuracy.
The prior six timing anchors and retained lexical errors do not establish general acoustic timing or ASR quality.
Sampled owned-process residency is not a kernel cap or whole-machine/long-recording resource approval.
Translation and summary meaning and reliable advertised-provider access remain open release gates.
